module_summary: GMII PHY interface wrapping source-synchronous SDR input/output cells for RX and TX, a MII/GMII TX clock mux and per-domain reset synchronizer shift registers.

anchors.name: phy_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Receive data byte from PHY captured by the SDR input cell

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Registered receive data forwarded to the MAC

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: Receive data valid to MAC, captured alongside rxd

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: Transmit data byte from MAC into the SDR output cell

anchors.name: phy_gmii_txd
anchors.why: Retimed transmit data driven to the PHY

anchors.name: phy_gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: Transmit enable to PHY qualifying txd

anchors.name: mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII PHY tx clock or system clk as MAC transmit clock

anchors.name: tx_rst_reg
anchors.why: 4-bit shift register synchronizing reset into the TX clock domain

anchors.name: rx_rst_reg
anchors.why: 4-bit shift register synchronizing reset into the RX clock domain

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_rst
anchors.why: Synchronized TX-domain reset output from tx_rst_reg

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rx_rst
anchors.why: Synchronized RX-domain reset output from rx_rst_reg

groups.name: RX SDR capture
groups.description: Captures PHY receive bus on forwarded rx clock and presents it to MAC

groups.name: TX SDR output
groups.description: Retimes MAC transmit bus and forwards clock to the PHY

groups.name: TX clock select
groups.description: Muxes system clk or MII tx clock as MAC transmit clock

groups.name: Reset synchronizers
groups.description: Shift-register reset synchronizers for TX and RX clock domains
